title: The global epidemiology of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH): a systematic review.

model.rationale: All claims in the generated text accurately reflect the reference, including study design (systematic review with meta-analysis per PRISMA), population (adults ≥20 years, sample sizes, characteristics), methods (searches, inclusion/exclusion, JBI quality assessment, random-effects pooling, post hoc adjustments, subgroup and meta-regression), and results (prevalence 30.05%, regional rates, incidence 48.89/1000 PY, mortality rates, 2019 case estimates, NASH estimates). Numerical values, confidence intervals, p-values, and heterogeneity measures are replicated without fabrication. The discussion and limitations are faithfully summarized without introducing unsupported statements.
